diagnosis: Job EXP-40233 (6 GB, eu-central) has been running ~7 hours, exceeding the ~1 hour expected for jobs under 10 GB; per kb-0005 it has stalled and should be cancelled and resubmitted.
reply: Thank you for the details. Export jobs under 10 GB normally finish within about an hour, so a job that has been running for roughly seven hours, like EXP-40233, has stalled. The recommended fix is to cancel the job and resubmit it; resubmitted jobs are queued per region. If the resubmitted job also stalls, please let us know and we can investigate further.
